{{Quote|They say I'm the worst kind of pirate, ambushing unarmed ships to steal their cargoes. I say that's the best kind of pirate.|Kath Scarlet|<ref name="TNR-KS">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Kath Scarlet}}</ref>}}
'''Kath Scarlet''' was the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Binayre Pirates]], a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] that operated within the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Scarlet preyed upon unarmed [[Starship/Legends|starships]] passing through Corellian [[Realspace/Legends|space]], using her [[Kath Scarlet's Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft|''Firespray-31''-class]] [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|patrol and attack craft]] to ambush them and capture their cargo. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] dispatched a team to destroy a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], Scarlet attacked and boarded their [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] as it emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], only to be driven back by the well-armed Imperials. Around the same [[Time/Legends|time]], she attempted to take possession of the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] ''[[Dire Hound]]'' from its [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] owner, but retreated when the spacer defended the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Permission to come aboard? Oh never mind, I'm already here. I'm Kath Scarlet, captain of the Binayre pirates, and I don't like trouble. Surrender and take me to your cargo hold. Or die. Up to you.|Kath Scarlet|<ref name="SOC-KS" />}}
[[File:KathScarlet.jpg|thumb|left|190px|Kath Scarlet in action]]
The [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="SOC-KS" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]] Kath Scarlet operated as a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]]. By the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], she was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Binayre Pirates]],<ref name="DS" /> a group of pirates and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] based out of the [[Double Worlds|twin worlds]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] and [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]],<ref name="CSD">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80112|text=CorSec Database A-G|int=CorSec Database A-G}}</ref> who controlled several areas of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]], including the [[Trifecta Star]] and the [[Rayless Lantern]].<ref name="CotF-BP">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|cardname=Binayre Pirate}}</ref> Scarlet preyed upon [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] vessels passing through the area,<ref name="DS" /> hiding her [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]] [[Kath Scarlet's Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft|''Firespray-31''-class]] [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|patrol and attack craft]] among [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] to ambush and capture unwary [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="SOC-PT">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Pirate Trap}}</ref>

During the Galactic Civil War, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] learned of a secret [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base on Talus and dispatched several [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] from the [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal Academy]] to seek out and destroy it. Scarlet's Firespray was nearby when the Imperial squad's [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. Believing the new arrival to be a cargo vessel, Scarlet attacked, using her ship's [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] to target the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle's]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], disabling it and preventing the ship from escaping. The stricken shuttle was then grappled and boarded, with Scarlet personally leading several pirates in a boarding party. Met by the shuttle's crew, Scarlet demanded that they surrender and take her to their cargo hold. However, the Imperials refused and drew their hidden weapons, leading to a vicious firefight in which the Imperials managed to gain the upper hand. Sensing the situation worsening for her side, Scarlet deftly escaped back through the airlock to her Firespray and escaped before the Imperials could repair their hyperdrive to give chase, though several of her pirates ended up in Imperial custody.<ref name="DS" />

Around the same [[Time/Legends|time]], the Binayre Pirates learned of a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was in the Corellian system to recover the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] ''[[Dire Hound]]'', which had previously belonged to their aunt [[Evgenia]], from a secret [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] on Talus. The Empire too had learned of the Z-95 and dispatched a team led by [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] agent [[Jeffren Brek]] to impound it. Scarlet and a group of Binayres followed the Imperials to the hangar and waited while a shootout developed between Brek's team and the spacer. Only when the Imperials were driven back did the pirates reveal themselves to the spacer. With her [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] aimed at the spacer, Scarlet demanded that they turn the Z-95 over to her, but the spacer intended to defend their property and put up a short, but brutal firefight. Deciding that the price was not worth the effort, Scarlet and a couple of her pirates escaped, leaving the spacer alone.<ref name="LS" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You look good in this Headhunter. Not as good as I'm going to look, of course. Come down here and give up so I don't have to clean up a mess in the cockpit.|Kath Scarlet|<ref name="SOC-KS2">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Kath Scarlet|swglink=Kath Scarlet (Avatar Light) (card).JPG}}</ref>}}
[[File:Pirate_Trap_SOC.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Scarlet's ''Firespray'' ambushing a lone Z-95 Headhunter]]
Kath Scarlet was a cunning pirate whose favorite trick was to hide her vessel among asteroids to take ships unaware<ref name="SOC-PT" /> and who did not hesitate to attack an unarmed vessel.<ref name="TNR-KS" /> Most pilots preferred to trail targets at a short distance, allowing them to fire while staying out of their target's own firing arc. Scarlet, however, to overshoot her opponents in an opening tilt and use a series of unpredictable, low-speed maneuvers to get into firing position and catch them off-guard. She was sometimes known to use a [[Koiogran turn]] to move directly in front of her adversary and rely on her own skills to fire before her enemy.<ref name="FFG">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2014/11/3/the-galaxys-most-wanted-part-two|text=The Galaxy's Most Wanted, Part Two}}</ref> After disabling a target she would board it and give the crew one chance to surrender their cargo to her, but was willing to kill if necessary.<ref name="DS" /> She would also pursue targets of a personal interest, seeking to capture the Z-95 Headhunter ''Dire Hound'' after taking a liking to its uprated [[2b fission engine]]s and bubble canopy.<ref name="LS" /> Under her leadership, the Binayre Pirates were well-armed and organized. However, Scarlet put her own wellbeing ahead of her crew's, fleeing a fight with Imperial forces while leaving several of her crew behind to be captured. She was often sarcastic when addressing her victims and even winked at the Imperials when fleeing their shuttle.<ref name="DS" /> Scarlet was typically clad in a [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]] and carried a heavy blaster pistol.<ref name="LS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kath Scarlet was created for ''[[Squadrons Over Corellia]]'', an expansion set for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'',<ref name="SOC-KS" /> released on [[December 16]], [[2008]].<ref name="SOCR">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68142&month=122008|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies Trading Card Game: Squadrons Over Corellia Loot Has Been Revealed!}}</ref> Scarlet is involved in both the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] and [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] campaigns and is depicted on the "Kath Scarlet" card.<ref name="SOC-KS" /><ref name="LS" /><ref name="DS" /> Game designer [[Chuck Kallenbach]] teased players with the possibility of Scarlet choosing a side in the Galactic Civil War.<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=strategygames/posts/list.m?topic_id=24090|text=Q+A Answers for 12/4 - 12/17/2009}}</ref>
